title: amlc run configuration
description: Generated by `amlc describe --schema` from amlc/registry.py. Parameters use dotted keys (e.g. "ramp.steps"); in TOML these may also be written as nested tables.

seed.description: seed of numpy.random.default_rng; if omitted, run picks one and records it

parameters.description: model parameters (dotted names may be nested tables)

sweep.description: sweep only: {parameter name: [values]}; the Cartesian product is run

leverage.mean.description: Mean leverage l. Account leverage is max(1, l*(1 + s*Z)), Z standard normal. Higher l lowers breach thresholds and makes the cohort more fragile. Unit: dimensionless.

leverage.dispersion.description: Relative leverage dispersion s in max(1, l*(1 + s*Z)). Larger s spreads thresholds; at fixed impact strength it moves the system away from the cusp. Unit: dimensionless.

maintenance.ratio.description: Maintenance-margin ratio m, common to all accounts. Breach threshold field t = (1/leverage - m)/(1 - m). Unit: dimensionless.

exposure.tilt.description: Exposure-leverage tilt chi = rho_qz * s_q entering the exposure-weighted threshold quantile t(B). Unit: dimensionless.

impact.strength.description: Impact strength Lambda: drawdown added when the sold exposure fraction x has normalized impact f(x) (f(1)=1). Above the onset value the equality map folds and the cascade becomes discontinuous. Unit: dimensionless.

impact.law.description: Normalized impact function f of sold exposure fraction. Unit: dimensionless.

cusp.drawdown.description: Initiating drawdown d0 at which the cusp (critical Lambda_c and cusp leverage l*) is located for square-root impact. Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

map.points.description: Number of grid points in B for the recorded equality map d0(B) on [1e-6, 0.9]. Unit: dimensionless.

leverage.mean.description: Mean leverage l. Account leverage is max(1, l*(1 + s*Z)), Z standard normal. Higher l lowers breach thresholds and makes the cohort more fragile. Unit: dimensionless.

leverage.dispersion.description: Relative leverage dispersion s in max(1, l*(1 + s*Z)). Larger s spreads thresholds; at fixed impact strength it moves the system away from the cusp. Unit: dimensionless.

exposure.kind.description: Distribution of account exposures: 'equal' (all 1), 'lognormal' (correlated with leverage through exposure.leverage_corr), or 'pareto' (independent of leverage, tail index exposure.tail_index). Unit: dimensionless.

exposure.log_sd.description: Log-standard deviation s_q of lognormal exposures Q = exp(s_q*(rho*Z + sqrt(1-rho^2)*U)). Unit: dimensionless.

exposure.leverage_corr.description: Correlation rho between log exposure and the leverage normal Z. Exposure tilt chi = rho*s_q; positive tilt puts more exposure on high-leverage accounts and lowers the critical impact strength. Unit: dimensionless.

exposure.tail_index.description: Pareto tail index mu of exposures Q = (1-U)^(-1/mu). Smaller mu means heavier tails, slower finite-N narrowing of the collapse field, and a late-collapse tail. Unit: dimensionless.

cohort.sizes.description: Cohort sizes N, one block of independent cohorts per size, simulated in this order from one random stream (as in exp_finiteN.py / exp_pareto.py). Unit: accounts.

cohort.counts.description: Number of cohorts R for each entry of cohort.sizes (same length). Unit: cohorts.

cohort.count.description: Number of independent cohorts simulated. Unit: cohorts.

histogram.log10_max.description: log10 of the largest logarithmic bin edge before the final doubled bin. Unit: dimensionless.

histogram.points.description: Number of logarithmically spaced edges before rounding and de-duplication. Unit: dimensionless.

avalanche.near_fold_window.description: Avalanches whose field lies within this distance below the collapse field are counted as near-fold. Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

cohort.size.description: Number of accounts N in each simulated cohort. Unit: accounts.

cohort.count.description: Number of independent cohorts simulated. Unit: cohorts.

maintenance.mean.description: Mean of the per-account maintenance ratio in the path model (normal, truncated at +-4 sd). Unit: dimensionless.

maintenance.sd.description: Standard deviation of the per-account maintenance ratio in the path model. Unit: dimensionless.

execution.delay_mean.description: Mean of the Poisson execution delay: consecutive breached steps an account waits before selling. Unit: time steps.

execution.sale_rate_mean.description: Mean of the Beta-distributed per-step sale cap (fraction of the position an account may sell per step). Unit: fraction of position per step.

execution.sale_rate_sd.description: Standard deviation of the Beta-distributed per-step sale cap. Unit: fraction of position per step.

impact.strength.description: Impact strength Lambda: drawdown added when the sold exposure fraction x has normalized impact f(x) (f(1)=1). Above the onset value the equality map folds and the cascade becomes discontinuous. Unit: dimensionless.

impact.half_life.description: Half-life h_I of the unabsorbed impact stock in the path model; the stock decays by 2^(-1/h_I) per step. Any value <= 0 means permanent impact. Short half-lives fragment the cascade. Unit: time steps.

price.relaxation.description: Rate gamma at which the drawdown relaxes toward d0 + Lambda*f(U) each step in the path model. Unit: per time step.

price.drawdown_cap.description: Upper cap on the total drawdown d in the path model. Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

ramp.start.description: External drawdown d0 at step 0 of the linear ramp. Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

ramp.end.description: External drawdown d0 reached at the end of the ramp and then held. Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

ramp.steps.description: Ramp duration T (steps) from ramp.start to ramp.end. Slower ramps sharpen the transition in d0 (width ~ tau_c*(end-start)/T). Unit: time steps.

ramp.hold_steps.description: Steps simulated after the ramp with d0 held at ramp.end. Unit: time steps.

diagnostics.window.description: Window W (steps) for the largest W-step increase of the sold fraction (largest event). Unit: time steps.

diagnostics.event_threshold.description: A W-step increase above this counts as an event (n_events counts up-crossings). Unit: dimensionless (fraction of total exposure).

diagnostics.reference_field.description: External field at which the sold fraction is reported (sold_at_reference). Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

diagnostics.late_margin.description: A cohort is 'late' if its midpoint field exceeds the median midpoint field by more than this. Unit: dimensionless (fractional price drawdown).

bm.dt.description: Time step of the discretized Brownian motion. Unit: dimensionless.

bm.horizon.description: One-sided horizon V of the two-sided Brownian motion. Unit: dimensionless.

bm.samples.description: Number of Monte Carlo samples R. Unit: dimensionless.

cohort.size.description: Number of accounts N in each simulated cohort. Unit: accounts.

holder.shares.description: Shares omega of total exposure held by one conservative holder (0 = no holder). Unit: dimensionless (fraction of total exposure).

holder.leverage_z.description: Leverage quantile z of the conservative holder: leverage max(1, l*(1 + s*z)). Unit: dimensionless.

holder.background_loss.description: Fraction of the background cohort's own exposure whose loss defines the reported field. Unit: dimensionless (fraction of total exposure).
